problem_text:
A logistics company needs to select packages to load onto a cargo drone. The available packages are:
* Package 1: size 39 units, revenue 179 credits
* Package 2: size 18 units, revenue 49 credits
* Package 3: size 30 units, revenue 91 credits
* Package 4: size 7 units, revenue 272 credits
* Package 5: size 17 units, revenue 296 credits
* Package 6: size 46 units, revenue 217 credits
* Package 7: size 39 units, revenue 239 credits
* Package 8: size 27 units, revenue 91 credits
* Package 9: size 39 units, revenue 224 credits
* Package 10: size 50 units, revenue 74 credits
* Package 11: size 44 units, revenue 67 credits
* Package 12: size 38 units, revenue 67 credits
* Package 13: size 12 units, revenue 256 credits
* Package 14: size 19 units, revenue 61 credits
* Package 15: size 44 units, revenue 227 credits
* Package 16: size 17 units, revenue 151 credits
* Package 17: size 8 units, revenue 192 credits

The drone has a maximum capacity of 345 units. Choose the package combination that maximizes total revenue without exceeding this capacity. Each package must be either fully loaded or left behind.
